notes.title: Update 21 - Re-amped algorithm
notes.content:
Hi there! Time for a big update now. We have now completely reworked the training algorithm to better suit a more modular way of thinking of we want to add more things in the future. The algorithm will also be better in many ways.

You now need a trainer/coach to train a specific disciplin. We hope that you like the changes we have added and hope to get your thoughts and feedback.


[list]
    [*]Completely reprogrammed the training algorithm, the training is now buffed to be much more realistic (more tweaking will come in the weeks that follow)
    [*]No training before buying a coach for a specific training regime, from now on to keep everything even more realistic, you can't train e.g. boxing if you don't have a boxing coach etc. forcing the player to be more tactical regarding the finances of the gym
    [*]Small text fixes
    [*]Various performance/bug fixes
[/list]

Hope you all had a great weekend!

    *Spinning Back Fist
    *Axe Kick
    *Body Lock (takedown)
    *Suplex (takedown)

    [*]Fixed the height on the scrolling info bar
    [*]Redesigned the health bars
[/list]

Here is the latest patchlog

[list]
    [*]Fixed the weird name in header.

notes.title: Update 15 - Promotions
notes.content:
We are now officially back after a time of absent, it was tough keeping the project going financially after missing deadlines multiple times and pushing the release.

But we have now solved that for now and pushing forward! The ambition is still to create the an amazing MMA manager simulator.

Here is update number 15.

We have solved a bit of the play by play bug where the order of moves from the fighter was not correct. But there is a small problem left where the first move that the fighters make are not shown but it should be solved asap.

So the latest update includes.

[list]
    [*]Promotions (You now get emails to setup fights)
    [*]Play by play icons
    [*]Synced fight animation and messages (known issues: the first move seems to be off)
    [*]Fight algorithm balansing
    [*]Tons of bug fixes
[/list]

We hope now that we can keep up with the weekly updates!

So we have been busy working on getting the algorithm to work properly and we have finally gotten some good results. Fights can now end in submission, TKO, KO and Judges Decision.

But a pesky bug has appeared that messes upp the play by play timeline. We are currently working on this to get it sorted out.

But please test out the fights and give us feedback on the fights.

With that out of the way here is the latest update.

[list]

    [*]New fighter emails if you have the gym space.
    [*]Fight Algorithm update
    [*]Equipment details added (Work in progress)
    [*]Finish day indicator (Work in progress)
[/list]
